expected_answer: An academic paper (D3 Re § 21 Para. 1). It may be done as group work if individual contributions are clearly separable (D1 § 21 Abs. 4) and may be carried out with a company with the Prüfungsausschuss chair's approval (D1 § 21 Abs. 2)
actual_answer: CONFLICT - The passages contradict each other regarding the nature of the Master's thesis.   According to D3 § 21 Sätze 1–2 (binding), "The Master's thesis consists of the preparation of an academic paper."   However, D4 (NOT binding) describes the course as an "Independent final project" and specifies the requirements as an "Independently conducted scientific project" [D4].   Neither passage states that the thesis is an internship.
